big_case.notes: Damages-only suit by Washington healthcare workers over the state's COVID-19 healthcare-worker vaccine mandate against a former governor and a private hospital system; unpublished Ninth Circuit affirmance controlled by the published Curtis v. Inslee, whose own petition the Court denied June 1, 2026 without writing, alongside sibling petitions on the same theories. The EUA-versus-licensed labeling and PREP Act court-access questions are time-bound and have drawn a uniform line of denials; the denial here came after one conference with no noted dissent. Low stakes beyond the parties.
